## Overview

This DuitNow Web page was captured on 2026-09-15 and carries 2019-09-30 last-modified metadata. It is a chooser for website integration: Web Drop-in or a prebuilt Web Component. It contains no payment setup or outcome procedure and does not establish current merchant availability. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in option links [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-duitnow-web-drop-in]] and is described as an all-in-one UI solution. The Components option links [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-duitnow-web-component]] and is described as a prebuilt Component that renders DuitNow on a website. The page also links the general Web Drop-in and Components documentation.
- This chooser does not specify Sessions or Advanced flow, API/SDK versions, eligibility, request fields, QR presentation, expiry, shopper action, or webhook outcome. Those topics require the linked method-specific and base guides. The 2019 last-modified metadata is a source timestamp, not proof of current behavior.
